subject: physics
content: A TV transmission tower has a height of 140 m and the height of the receiving antenna is 40 m. What is the maximum distance upto which signals can be broadcasted from this tower is LOS (Line of Sight) mode ? (Given : radius of earth = 6.4 × 10<sup>6</sup> m).
